answer: Require each new agent to lock a stake in a time-locked vault that only unlocks after its work has been graded by independent peers over many epochs. Treat reputation like a garden: it grows slowly from attested contributions and cannot be bought outright, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities yields a thousand empty plots. Slashing the vault when graders catch duplicated output makes the cost of a sybil swarm crystal clear before it can ever pay off.
